name: nvda-forecast-agent
description: Agent #2 of AI Michel — a daily AI agent that forecasts NVDA closing price from semiconductor indices, volatility, the dollar, and bond yields, with adaptive self-learning weights. Deploys to AWS (Lambda + EventBridge Scheduler + DynamoDB + S3 static dashboard).

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npx tsx --test test_nvda_forecast.ts test_adaptive.ts
scripts.test:long: npm run typecheck && RUN_LONG_TESTS=1 npx tsx --test test_nvda_forecast.ts test_adaptive.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run build && sam deploy --stack-name nvdaforecast-stack --region us-east-1 --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM --no-confirm-changeset --resolve-s3 --profile nvda
